description: This file defines the AzureTableGrainStorage class, which implements grain storage using Azure Table Storage within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, as well as internal serialization/deserialization logic and table management.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements Orleans grain storage using Azure Table Storage, handling serialization, table interactions, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of AzureTableGrainStorage with dependency injection.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state from Azure Table Storage and populates the grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes and writes grain state to Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes grain state from Azure Table Storage based on configuration.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state into Azure Table entity properties, supporting binary or string formats.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes stored Azure Table entity data back into grain state object.

methods.name: GetKeyString
methods.description: Generates a sanitized partition key string based on grain ID and service ID.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the storage provider, including table setup.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the storage provider is shutting down.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a grain state object using the activator provider.
